prompt: We are about to build the hold-requests feature described in docs/. Make an implementation plan and save it to plan.md. I need: measurable success criteria, a prioritized task breakdown where every task has an effort estimate in days and a priority of High, Medium or Low, which tasks block which and which can run in parallel, which role should do each task, a phased timeline with a total that includes a buffer, and a final execution plan with a verification phase and a documentation phase. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

checks.cmd: c=0; h=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(#+[[:space:]]|[*][*][^*]+[*][*]:?[[:space:]]*$)' plan.md 2>/dev/null); for p in 'success|criteria' 'task|breakdown' 'depend|block|parallel' 'role|owner|assign' 'timeline|phase|schedule'; do printf '%s\n' "$h" | grep -qiE "$p" && c=$((c+1)); done; [ "$c" -ge 4 ]

c=0; for p in 'backend|engineer|developer' 'qa|test engineer|tester|quality' 'devops|sre|operations|platform' 'product|pm|owner' 'design|ux|frontend|front.end'; do cat plan.md 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "$p" && c=$((c+1)); done; [ "$c" -ge 3 ]

rubric.criterion: Success criteria are measurable pass/fail statements that cover placing a hold, first-come queue order, email on return, cancel, and expiry.
Every task has an effort estimate in days and a High, Medium or Low priority.
States which tasks block others and names at least one pair of tasks that can run in parallel, with no circular dependency.
Notes the 7-day (REQ-3) versus 5-day (REQ-6) reservation conflict as an assumption or open item.
The total effort is shown as a serial sum plus an explicit buffer percentage.
The execution plan has separate verification and documentation phases.
